entries.title: Psalms 116:1
segments: I love Jehovah, because he heareth My voice and my supplications.

entries.title: Psalms 116:2
segments: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, Therefore will I call [upon him] as long as I live.

entries.title: Psalms 116:3
segments: The cords of death compassed me, And the pains of Sheol  gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

entries.title: Psalms 116:4
segments: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah: O Jehovah, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 116:5
segments: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous; Yea, our God is merciful.

entries.title: Psalms 116:6
segments: Jehovah preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.

entries.title: Psalms 116:7
segments: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; For Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.

entries.title: Psalms 116:8
segments: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, [And] my feet from falling.

entries.title: Psalms 116:9
segments: I will walk before Jehovah In the land of the living.

entries.title: Psalms 116:10
segments: I  believe, for I will speak: I was greatly afflicted:

entries.title: Psalms 116:11
segments: I said in my  haste, All men are liars.

entries.title: Psalms 116:12
segments: What shall I render unto Jehovah For all his benefits toward me?

entries.title: Psalms 116:13
segments: I will take the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 116:14
segments: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people.

entries.title: Psalms 116:15
segments: Precious in the sight of Jehovah Is the death of his saints.

entries.title: Psalms 116:16
segments: O Jehovah, truly I am thy servant: I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bonds.

entries.title: Psalms 116:17
segments: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 116:18
segments: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people,

entries.title: Psalms 116:19
segments: In the courts of Jehovah's house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem.  Praise ye Jehovah.
